events.title: "Lemonade of the Land" at Del Valle
events.venue: Del Valle Visitor Center, 7000 Del Valle Rd
events.why: A free naturalist-led program making homemade lemonade from plants foraged in the park, and you can pair it with a swim at Del Valle's beach on the same $10 parking fee.

events.title: $5 Day at The Lawrence Hall of Science
events.venue: Lawrence Hall of Science, 1 Centennial Drive
events.why: A holiday-only $5 admission to a science museum genuinely pitched at older kids (biotech, AI, and animal encounters), with a free shuttle from Downtown Berkeley BART and one of the best views in the Bay.

events.title: 63rd Annual Kings Mountain Art Fair in the Redwoods
events.venue: Kings Mountain Community Center & Firehouse, 13889 Skyline Blvd
events.why: The closest thing to a hometown Labor Day tradition for a Menlo Park family: 130+ artists under old-growth redwoods 25 minutes up Highway 35, free entry, kids' activities, and a volunteer-run Cookshack whose proceeds fund the local fire brigade and elementary school.

events.title: Abbots Bromley Horn Dance + Picnic (California Revels)
events.venue: Joaquin Miller Park, Joaquin Miller Rd & Sanborn Dr
events.why: A genuinely odd and wonderful annual ritual: a centuries-old English horn dance staged in a forest glade, where antlers and hobby horses are handed out and your kids can join the dance rather than watch it.

events.title: BBQ on the Lawn with The Sons of Champlin
events.venue: Rancho Nicasio
events.why: An outdoor Marin roadhouse BBQ with a legendary 1960s Marin horn band, and the drive out through Nicasio Valley is half the reason to go.

events.title: Bolinas Labor Day BBQ & White Elephant Auction
events.venue: Bolinas Community Center, 14 Wharf Rd
events.why: The Bolinas Community Center's biggest fundraiser of the year, with three stages of live music running to 8pm and a White Elephant silent auction — the archetypal small-town coastal Labor Day that never shows up in a ticketing feed.

events.title: Concannon Estate Labor Day Block Party
events.venue: Concannon Vineyard, 4590 Tesla Rd
events.why: Free admission to the lawn of one of California's oldest continuously operating wineries, with live music and wood-fired pizza, so the kids have room to run while the adults have something to drink.

events.title: Forever Grateful, Golden Gate Park (Opening Weekend)
events.venue: San Francisco County Fair Building (Hall of Flowers), 1199 9th Ave
events.why: Opening-weekend immersive Grateful Dead exhibition with the original Furthur bus and Jerry Garcia's BMW parked inside, and it sits a short walk from the free jam in Robin Williams Meadow.

events.title: Free Shakespeare in the Park: Antony and Cleopatra
events.venue: Jerry Garcia Amphitheater, McLaren Park
events.why: Free, no tickets needed, 90 minutes with no intermission, and Labor Day Monday is one of the few weekday performances in the McLaren Park run.

events.title: Giro di San Francisco: 50th Anniversary Criterium Bike Race
events.venue: Levi's Plaza, 1255 Battery St
events.why: A 50th-anniversary edition of a race run every Labor Day since 1976, and elite riders cornering hard on a tight waterfront circuit is exactly the kind of free spectating that holds a 9-to-14-year-old's attention for hours.

events.title: Golden Gate Free Jam: Grahame Lesh & Friends
events.venue: Robin Williams Meadow (Sharon Meadow), Golden Gate Park
events.why: A free four-hour set played from a flatbed truck in Golden Gate Park, deliberately echoing the 1960s free concerts, and a painless way to show kids where Bay Area music history actually happened.

events.title: Golden Gate Park Band's Free Labor Day "Symphony in the Park"
events.venue: Spreckels Temple of Music (Golden Gate Park Bandshell)
events.why: The Golden Gate Park Band has played this bandshell since the 1880s, and the free 105-minute Labor Day concert pairs perfectly with a picnic and the rest of the park.

events.title: Hiero Day (14th Annual)
events.venue: The Midway
events.why: Hieroglyphics' fourteenth annual Labor Day hip-hop festival, this year with Killer Mike and DJ Jazzy Jeff, is a Bay Area institution that only exists on this one day of the year.

events.title: Japanese Tea Garden Free Admission Hour
events.venue: Japanese Tea Garden, Golden Gate Park
events.why: Free entry from 9 to 10am to a garden that normally costs $12 to $16 a head, and arriving before the holiday crowds means the drum bridge is actually climbable.

events.title: Labor Day Bonfire Night at Ocean Beach
events.venue: Ocean Beach Fire Pits
events.why: Beach fires become legal again for the season on Labor Day weekend, and the sixteen first-come fire pits are free, though you need to arrive early to claim one.

events.title: Labor Day Weekend "Salute to Heroes" at Gilroy Gardens
events.venue: Gilroy Gardens Family Theme Park
events.why: The last day of the season's Carnival Nights runs into the evening alongside the regular rides and water play, and military, veterans, ER staff, and first responders get in free with ID plus up to six discounted guest tickets.

events.title: Labor Day Weekend at Balestrieri Family Farm
events.venue: Balestrieri Family Farm, 6140 Alhambra Valley Rd
events.why: A working family farm opening its gates for the holiday with food, farm animals, and tasting for the adults, tucked in the Alhambra Valley hills most Peninsula families have never driven through.

events.title: Labor Day Weekend at Roaring Camp Railroads
events.venue: Roaring Camp Railroads, 5400 Graham Hill Rd
events.why: Ride the Redwood Forest Steam Train or the Santa Cruz Beach Train, then stay in the Town of Roaring Camp for gold panning, a working blacksmith, and printing-press demonstrations — book the train in advance, holiday departures sell out.

events.title: Labor Day at Black Diamond Mines Regional Preserve
events.venue: Black Diamond Mines Regional Preserve, 5175 Somersville Rd
events.why: A real coal and sand mining district open on the holiday, with the underground visitor center and mining-history exhibits — a fitting Labor Day outing and a strong fit for kids old enough to care how things were dug.

events.title: Monterey County Fair — Kids Day
events.venue: Monterey County Fair & Event Center, 2004 Fairground Rd
events.why: The county-fair-scale trip worth the two-hour drive: carnival rides, livestock shows, and arena entertainment until 10pm, with kids 12 and under free all day on the Labor Day Kids Day.

events.title: Walnut Creek Concert Band Free Labor Day "ParKoncert"
events.venue: Civic Park, 1375 Civic Drive
events.why: The band's annual free hour-long outdoor concert of movie soundtracks and marches closes out the long weekend, and a lawn blanket at 6pm is a gentle way to end the day.
